chunks: With fruits hanging low within reach,

key_terms.قُطُوفُهَا: Its fruits (specifically hanging clusters of fruit)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the fruits of Paradise are 'daniyah' (close/easy to reach)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the immediate gratification of the righteous, contrasting with the delayed or difficult access to worldly rewards. It underscores the divine generosity where the fruits of Jannah are not distant ideals but tangible realities within reach, reflecting the concept of 'Qurb' (closeness) to God's blessings.
